title: Silksong: Sea of Sorrow news drops November 27 🌊
subject: silksong
description:
Release date or delay, what's your guess? 👇

Team Cherry announced a Cherry Time presentation for November 27, 2026 at 10 AM ET (7 AM PT / 3 PM GMT) on its YouTube channel, with an update on Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow and other announcements. Sea of Sorrow is a free expansion first revealed in December 2025 with a 2026 window.

Sources: Team Cherry on Bluesky (Nov 25, 2026), Nintendo Life (Nov 25, 2026), Beebom (Nov 25, 2026)
Game footage/images © Team Cherry.

scenes.text: Silksong's free expansion finally gets an update on November 27.
Team Cherry announced it on Bluesky on November 25.
The Cherry Time stream starts at 10 a.m. Eastern on Team Cherry's YouTube channel.
It promises a Sea of Sorrow update and other announcements.
Sea of Sorrow was revealed in December 2025 with a 2026 window. It sends Hornet across and beneath a mysterious ocean.
With just over a month left in 2026, Nintendo Life expects either a release date or a delay.
